description: This dataset includes data tables and R scripts used for the statistical analysis of the article: Kirsch, F., Haß, A. L., Link, W. and Westphal, C. (2022): “Intercrops as foraging habitats for bees: Bees do not prefer sole legume crops over legume-cereal mixtures” (published in Agric Ecosyst Environ, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.agee.2022.108268). See R scripts for further details.
keywords: pollination, behavior, breeding, yield, plant traits, V. faba

distribution.name: Bean_genotype_crop_stand_traits.R
distribution.description: R script to analyze differences between V. faba genotypes and cropping systems in terms of the crop stand traits LAI per plot, V. faba plant height in cm per plot and number of V. faba inflorescences per plot. Please run this script with the data table "Bean_genotype_crop_stand_traits.csv".

distribution.name: Bean_genotype_crop_stand_traits.tab
distribution.description: Please use this data table for the R script "Bean_genotype_crop_stand_traits.R".

distribution.name: Correlation_bean_genotype_crop_stand_traits.R
distribution.description: R script to analyze correlation between the crop stand traits LAI per plot, V. faba plant height in cm per plot and number of V. faba inflorescences per plot. Please run this script with the data table "Correlation_bean_genotype_crop_stand_traits.csv".

distribution.name: Correlation_bean_genotype_crop_stand_traits.tab
distribution.description: Please use this data table for the R script "Correlation_bean_genotype_crop_stand_traits.R".

distribution.name: Flower_visits_foraging_behavior.R
distribution.description: R script to analyze the effects of cropping system, V. faba genotypes and number of V. faba inflorescences on the number of flower visits by bees and their foraging behavior. Please run this script with the data table "Flower_visits_foraging_behaviour.csv".

distribution.name: Flower_visits_foraging_behavior.tab
distribution.description: Please use this data table to run the R script "Flower_visits_foraging_behavior.R".

distribution.name: yield.tab
distribution.description: Please use this data table to run the R script "yield_per_plant.R".

distribution.name: yield_per_plant.R
distribution.description: R script to analyze the effects of cropping system, V. faba genotypes, flower visits and foraging behavior on the yield per V. faba plant. Please run this script with the data table "yield.csv".
